blocks.text: Apartment interior design in New York, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 57 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a project for a 57 m² apartment in New York, USA: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a turnkey renovation.

The 57 m² space fits a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, an entrance hall, and a bathroom. The layout is planned so that the small floor area provides enough room for both living and storage.
The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, and storage systems were custom-made to the exact room dimensions, so the floor area is fully used and the interior looks cohesive.
Before work began, technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate were prepared, covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting.
The studio then carried out a turnkey renovation of the apartment according to the design, installed the custom-made furniture, and fitted out the rooms.
This page features 3D visualizations of the project and photos of the finished interior with the custom-made furniture, so you can compare the concept with the result.
